scope: Actual owner-scoped Sandbox rehearsal with one authenticated owner and a simulated seller perspective. Not real seller onboarding, escrow, or real seller settlement.

observedChain.version1: Seller delivery generated rule/layout findings; buyer saved four specific change requests. The first AI assessment failed generically and was not saved.
observedChain.version2: Seller supplied a revision and an assessment was saved; the original policy-copy false abstention remained visible.
observedChain.acceptance: Buyer separately checked mobile presentation, opening hours and policy source, then explicitly accepted this exact version. Form processing/email were excluded from scope.
observedChain.payment: PayPal Sandbox approval, authorization and separate confirmed capture completed for the same accepted delivery. The parent verified captured state after refresh.

savedAssessment.meaning: The buyer accepted independently verified policy copy despite this advisory uncertainty; the report was not silently changed to match a later experiment.

separateFollowups.sixPolicyCases: Separate direct source evaluations; no hosted database writes.
separateFollowups.twoWholeProjectVersions: Separate direct assessDelivery calls; these did not replace the saved hosted report.

publicationSanitization.excluded: Private owner/quote/delivery/report identifiers, authenticated URLs, PayPal order/authorization/capture identifiers, provider credentials and transport metadata.

limits: The seller side is simulated and the configured test merchant receives virtual test funds only.
The chain does not establish that every AI explanation or risk was correct, or that unimplemented form/email behavior works.
This summary is dated observed evidence, not a fresh transaction when a reviewer opens the repository.
